hold_text: Venue net P&L sweep, three fixes after the 17:36Z deploy of #25270. (1) STALL: 8 rows classified by 17:40Z then none; 87 Bybit rows from the last 7 days waiting, budget_deferred 46 per tick. Waiting rows re-read their windows every tick and ate the 4-read budget; a window read within 10 min is now served from the last result (a failed or could_not_look read is never held). Fewer venue calls, never a delay. (2) WINDOW: Bybit filters closed-pnl on created_time, which is when the CLOSING order was placed, and a bracket leg is placed at ENTRY (record 084e4c9f, trade 7054: created 11-11 12:02, filled 11-14 16:46). The old close-2h..+3h window missed every trade held more than ~2 h, and those rows would land venue_unmatched after 24 h. The window now starts an hour before the row's entry, clamped to Bybit's 7-day span. (3) GAP NOTES (manager GO 17:59Z): notes get venue_avg_entry / venue_avg_exit / venue_qty and, on a gap, pnl_gap_reason netting_position_avg_entry | entry_fill_differs | unexplained. A backfill pass fills rows classified before this, with notes keys only, through a guarded UPDATE (pnl_basis venue_net and notes unchanged since read). The stored pnl is never changed. Tests 20/20; the stall test and the long-hold window test each fail on the old code. order_monitor.py restarts the trader. Revert: git revert.
why: The venue-P&L sweep stalled, could not see trades held more than ~2 h, and its gaps did not explain themselves.
